items.prompt: What does the fixed-trace reference sum prove?

options.text: The real broker account has no missing executions
options.why: No actual account source is checked.

options.text: All disk and concurrency interleavings are safe
options.why: The component has neither persistence nor synchronization.
A successful fixture does not inject every resource failure.

options.text: The shown accepted synthetic fills reconcile arithmetically
options.why: Source completeness and durable behavior need separate evidence.

items.explanation: An independent synthetic reference is useful but does not authenticate external records.
